concept.title: Transitions
concept.shortdesc: Control how OBS Studio animates the change from one scene to another.

conbody.p: A transition plays whenever you switch the active scene. OBS Studio ships with several built-in transitions:

dlentry.dd: Crossfades from the old scene to the new one over a configurable duration.
Plays a short video clip, typically with a transparent or matte section, to cover the switch.
Uses a grayscale image to control the wipe pattern between scenes.

conbody.p: The default transition and its duration are set from the dropdown and duration field between the Scenes and Sources panels, and can be overridden per scene using Quick Transitions.
